### Travelers Recognized for Helping Military Families Build Careers


November 12, 2026


*Company named a Military Friendly® Employer, a* *Military Spouse Friendly® Employer and a Best for Vets Employer*


HARTFORD, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE:[TRV](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2F&esheet=54640198&newsitemid=20261112971864&lan=en-US&anchor=TRV&index=1&md5=4570c1cc5dd2def5045f5a451cb93d38) ) today announced it has once again earned the Gold rank on Viqtory, Inc.’s[Military Friendly® Employer](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.militaryfriendly.com%2Femployers%2F&esheet=54640198&newsitemid=20261112971864&lan=en-US&anchor=Military+Friendly%26%23174%3B+Employer&index=2&md5=14da917df2898375a382b9e7df956847) list and maintained its Military Spouse Friendly® Employer designation. The company was also named a[Best for Vets Employer](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fbestforvets.militarytimes.com%2Femployers%2F2026%2F&esheet=54640198&newsitemid=20261112971864&lan=en-US&anchor=Best+for+Vets+Employer&index=3&md5=89a05ed7d1cab1ba1eb1ca011019c67e) by Military Times, a distinction it has held for a number of years.


“Veterans and military families bring a sense of purpose and dedication that raises the bar for all of us,” said Diane Kurtzman, Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer at Travelers. “We’re proud to invest in programs and resources that help veterans and their spouses build meaningful careers. Whether they are still serving, transitioning to civilian life or relocating for their family’s next assignment, we strive to offer support that fits each stage.”


Travelers’ military-friendly culture is reflected in initiatives such as:


- An employee resource group that celebrates the skills and experiences of service members and veterans. Since its launch in 2013, the Military/Veterans & Allies Diversity Network has grown to more than 3,000 members.
- A recruiting program designed to open doors for military spouses. Since 2020, the company has hired more than 300 military spouses and created a forum where they can share advice, swap resources and encourage one another.
- A partnership with American Corporate Partners, a national nonprofit that pairs veterans and military spouses with career mentors. Since 2010, approximately 350 Travelers employees have taken part, mentoring more than 1,000 people, several of whom have joined the company.
- Comprehensive benefits for employees deployed on active duty, including full benefits in addition to supplementing military pay for up to five years of their deployment.


Over the years, Travelers has been named an Employer for Outstanding Support by the U.S. Navy Reserve and a Beyond the Yellow Ribbon company by the Minnesota National Guard. The company also participates in the Department of Defense Military Spouse Employment Partnership, which connects military spouses with employers dedicated to hiring and retaining them, and has long been a signatory of the Statement of Employer Support of the Guard and Reserve at both state and national levels.


To learn more about military-friendly programs at Travelers, visit[Travelers.com/military](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcareers.travelers.com%2Fmilitary%2F&esheet=54640198&newsitemid=20261112971864&lan=en-US&anchor=Travelers.com%2Fmilitary&index=4&md5=6193f1c0add8791cddbc3e54dad02715) .
